verdict: Both ad channels went dark this week; 28-day lead base stays intact.
narrative: This period you received 102 leads at an average cost of $16.02 per lead, driven almost entirely by Meta — but both Meta and Google Ads stopped spending on September 21 and delivered zero leads over the last seven days. That shutdown is the single biggest story this week and is being addressed directly alongside a set of overdue build milestones (landing pages, CRM automation, creative) that need to clear before campaigns can be restarted at scale. In the meantime, your Google Business Profile and direct traffic are holding some baseline activity, with 685 website sessions this period, though organic engagement softened week-over-week. Expect a campaign restart update within days; once ads are back on, lead flow should return to prior pacing.
